C1716.title: Post-2000s Woman in Shanghai Criminally Detained for Malicious Promo Abuse
C1716.summary: A woman born after 2000 in Shanghai registered on multiple ride-hailing platforms using several phone numbers, then refused to pay fares by filing false complaints, engaging in malicious promo abuse. She was ultimately placed under criminal detention by police. This case reveals a fraud pattern of refund abuse through fake complaints and payment refusal.
